articles.title: A Spacecraft Visits a Crashed Asteroid
articles.summary: Europe's Hera spacecraft has reached the asteroid Dimorphos to study the crash NASA's Dart spacecraft caused in a test to protect Earth.

articles.title: Is This El Niño a 'Mega' One?
articles.summary: People keep giving this year's El Niño bigger monster nicknames, but scientists say NOAA's top category is still simply very strong.

articles.title: Huawei Found Guilty of Stealing Secrets
articles.summary: A court in Brooklyn found Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets and bank fraud, but cleared it of the most serious charge, racketeering.
